# Third-party browser runtimes

Editra distributes pinned browser builds of these open-source projects:

| Component | Version | Purpose | License | Source |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| DOMPurify | 3.4.12 | HTML sanitization | Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0 | https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify |

The original license notices remain applicable to each component. Editra's
distribution script adds product metadata without changing the upstream
license or ownership.
